vulnerability_analysis: The setClaimRewardAsTokensPercentage function has no access control modifier (unlike other setter functions that use onlyOwner). This allows any address to set their own claim reward percentage to 100%, which would cause all their reward claims to be paid as LLG tokens instead of BNB. This could be exploited to manipulate token price or receive more favorable tax treatment.
attack_strategy: Directly call the vulnerable function setClaimRewardAsTokensPercentage(100) as the attacker to set the percentage to 100%.
step_by_step_plan:
1. Activate the contract by calling activate() as owner
2. Ensure attacker has enough LLG tokens to meet minRewardBalance
3. Call setClaimRewardAsTokensPercentage(100) as attacker
4. Verify the percentage was set to 100
